provenance.run: y88_fifo (Y-88 source runs 224476-79; FIFO gain curves + per-PMT FIFO factor from HV scan 224489)
provenance.method: ABSOLUTE Y-88 699 keVee Compton-edge equalization for the CURRENT (FIFO) readout. Each PMT 699 keVee edge (measured BNC-T, x per-PMT FIFO factor 1.13-1.65) is slid along its own FIFO gain-vs-V power law to a common target that keeps the fleet-mean HV unchanged.
provenance.hv_state: v_now = current fixed operating point (= the 224466 BNC-T median equalization, pss/hv_equalization_run224466.json v_suggested); FIFO readout, SiPM gating ON
caveats: Equalizes gain at the 0.699 MeV edge. Response is NOT perfectly linear, so the MIP (3.4 MeV) and trigger point (~1.7 MeV) are only equalized to ~+-12% RMS (arm A/DL ~15-30% below B/C/D at MIP scale). MIP spread improves ~1.8x -> ~1.4x.
Trigger fires ~1.7 MeV, above the 0.699 MeV equalization energy; for a <5%-uniform trigger point equalize at MIP/median scale (run224466 observable) or keep per-PMT thresholds.
FIFO factor = linear energy-independent analog gain (224466 BNC-T vs 224489 FIFO coincident medians).
power laws valid 1200-1600 V; BL/DR at 1440/1448 near the top.
re-derive after any PMT/base/FIFO change or re-take a quick Y-88.

target_rationale: geometric-mean-preserving: fleet-mean HV kept at 1301 V (overall gain unchanged, only rebalanced); absolute anchor = Y-88 699 keVee line.
